caption:
Oracle stock jumped 12.3% on Monday to $113.68 as Nvidia's board brought back Jensen Huang as CEO and AI stocks rebounded, and after Oracle said Friday its OpenAI financing is secured (Motley Fool).
The Nasdaq rose 6.51%, its best day since April 2025, yet Oracle still sits about 55% under its 52-week high of $250.25.
